photo.caption: Epidemiology is the study of health outcomes and diseases in specific populations.
photo.description: The study of health outcomes and diseases in specific populations.

photo.caption: Original map by John Snow showing the clusters of cholera cases in the London epidemic of 1854
photo.description: A variant of the original map drawn by Dr. John Snow (1813-1858), a British physician who is one of the founders of medical epidemiology, showing cases of cholera in the London epidemics of 1854, clustered around the locations of water pumps.
